project_description: Adaptive communication training platform that diagnoses WHY users struggle — not just WHAT they get wrong — and prescribes targeted exercises through five integrated practice surfaces: Voice Practice, Skills Lab, Simulation Studio, Institute, and VCM Diagnostics
core_hypothesis: A diagnostic engine that prescribes communication plans through motivational interviewing. Users don't just practice techniques in isolation — the platform identifies their behavioral bottleneck (via the Volitional Chain Model) and routes them to the right exercise at the right difficulty. The 'holy shit moment' expands from filler-word awareness to discovering WHY you avoid difficult conversations, freeze under pressure, or revert to old patterns.
target_users: Professionals who want to communicate more effectively in high-stakes situations — negotiations, difficult conversations, feedback delivery, conflict resolution. Initial beta: 5-50 testers. Target: anyone who would take a communication skills course but wants practice, not just theory.
success_metrics: Skill Progression: Do users advance through the 5-tier skill tree? (Tier 0 → Tier 2+ within 30 days)
Drill Completion Rate: Do users complete drills, not just start them? (target: >70%)
Simulation Engagement: Do users return to Simulation Studio after first session? (target: >50% within 7 days)
Retention: Do users maintain streaks and respond to spaced repetition prompts? (target: >40% 7-day retention check completion)
Mastery Decay: Do Proficient users maintain mastery at 14-day retention checks? (target: >80%)
Discovery Moment: Do users report surprise at diagnostic insights? (qualitative)
Technique Transfer: Do drill-trained users successfully apply techniques in simulation? (target: >60% transfer rate)
current_epic: Platform Foundation — Source of Truth Update + Architecture Setup

voice_practice.name: Voice Practice (Vocal Performance Lab)
voice_practice.description: Real-time voice analysis for filler words, pace, and vocal tonality. Users discover unconscious speaking habits through immediate feedback and playback.
key_features: Free practice mode with real-time filler gauge
WPM tracking and pace analysis
Hybrid filler detection (acoustic real-time + transcript reconciliation)
Audio playback with filler highlighting and timeline markers
Post-session transcript with toggle highlights (pace OR fillers)
Scorecard with metrics and AI summary (Gemini)
Hume.ai batch analysis for prosody, stress, freeze detection (needs backend proxy)

skills_lab.name: Skills Lab (Applied Skills)
skills_lab.description: Isolated drill engine for 57+ communication techniques across Voss, MI, CBT, NVC, and corporate frameworks. Generic drill engine supports 5 formats. Users build syntax mastery and automaticity before moving to simulation.
key_features: Generic drill engine supporting 5 formats: Prompt-Response, Audio-Spoken, Multiple-Choice, Rewrite, Spot-the-Technique
10 Tier A techniques (drills-first): mirroring, labeling, open-ended questions, 'I' statements, vocal tonality, FM DJ voice, 'No'-oriented questions, NVC observation, NVC feeling, contrasting

10 Tier C techniques (both drill + simulation): calibrated questions, tactical empathy, active listening, accusation audit, affirmations, paraphrasing, NVC need, NVC request, de-escalation, perspective-taking
Per-technique mastery tracking with drill-to-simulation threshold (e.g., 10 correct mirrors → unlock simulation)
4-dimension quality scoring: form + accuracy + impact + timing (R5 rubric)
Immediate feedback per drill attempt

simulation_studio.name: Simulation Studio
simulation_studio.description: Multi-turn AI roleplay powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash. Users practice techniques against AI opponents with graduated difficulty (cooperative → deceptive). State object pattern tracks AI mood, trust, concessions per turn.
key_features: Gemini 2.5 Flash AI opponents (~$0.01-0.02 per 15-min session)
5 difficulty levels: Cooperative, Hesitant, Resistant, Aggressive, Deceptive
3 simulation modes: Guided (technique prompted), Scaffolded (suggested), Free-form (post-detection only)
State object pattern: { mood, trust_level, concessions, revelation_stage } per turn
3 control dials per scenario: assertiveness, reactivity, emotional_volatility (1-5 each)
4-dimension scenario taxonomy: domain x difficulty x technique_focus x goal_type
Post-session technique detection and quality analysis
45 base scenarios for beta (x3 focus variations = 135 distinct experiences)
Hidden concerns with graduated revelation based on technique quality

institute.name: KDENZ Institute
institute.description: Educational content architecture with interleaved learning. Practice before exposure — users attempt techniques blind, THEN see expert demos. Videos, quizzes, articles, annotated examples.
key_features: 5 content types: video explainer, video demonstration, video before/after, article, annotated example
6 quiz formats: technique identification, scenario ranking, sentence rewrite, predictive, comparative, multiple choice
Interleaved learning (practice-before-exposure pattern from R12)
Content tied to skill tree — each technique has associated educational materials
Progress tracking per content module
AI-generated content initially, replaced with professional content over time

vcm_diagnostics.name: VCM Diagnostics (Diagnostic Engine)
vcm_diagnostics.description: 9-gate behavioral model based on the Volitional Chain Model V2. Identifies WHY users fail to change behavior — believability, desire, awareness, attention, will, intention, commitment, initiation, maintenance. Diagnoses internally, intervenes externally (users never see gate labels).
key_features: 9 sequential gates: C1 (Believability), C2 (Desire), C3 (Awareness), C4 (Attention), C5 (Will), C6 (Intention), C7 (Commitment), C8A (Initiation), C8B (Maintenance)
5-8 root causes per gate
Rule-based diagnostics first, graduate to ML after 3-6 months of data
Behavioral event logging — track all interactions, not just completions
Provisional vs confirmed diagnoses (need N>=2 sessions showing same pattern)
Meta flags: avoidance_flag, shutdown_flag, scripted_behavior_flag
Prescriptions map failing gates to specific exercises/nudges
Diagnose internally, intervene externally — users see positive framing, not gate labels

mastery_levels.2: Familiar (scored 70-99% in drill OR used correctly 1-2 times in roleplay)
mastery_levels.3: Proficient (scored 100% in drill OR used correctly 3+ times across multiple roleplays)
mastery_levels.4: Mastered (Proficient + demonstrated in mixed-skill assessment + retention check 7-14 days later)

tier_4.name: Expert / High-Stakes
tier_4.gate: All Mastered for Expert Communicator badge

specialization_tracks: Difficult Conversations (Crucial Conversations + Difficult Conversations + NVC)

research_validated.R1_hume_batch_api: VALIDATED — Hume batch API via backend proxy. Audio upload as blob, process post-session, 24h auto-delete. Prosody, stress, confidence, freeze detection all proven in POC.
research_validated.R3_adaptive_recommendations: VALIDATED — Hybrid architecture: 2:1 to 3:1 user-aligned to system-diagnosed ratio. Rule-based first, multi-armed bandit later. Ignored recommendations never repeated.
research_validated.R4_gemini_simulation: VALIDATED — Gemini 2.5 Flash for AI opponents. ~$0.01-0.02 per 15-min session. State object pattern ensures character consistency. Streaming responses for conversational pacing.
research_validated.R5_conversation_quality: VALIDATED — 4-dimension rubric: form (0-3) + accuracy (0-3) + impact (0-3) + timing (0-2). Composite = 0.25*form + 0.35*accuracy + 0.3*impact + 0.1*timing. Per-turn and session-end evaluation.
research_validated.R6_persistence_strategy: VALIDATED — Supabase for persistence (Postgres + Auth + Storage + Edge Functions). Migration path from localStorage. 22-table schema designed (R16).
research_validated.R7_audio_storage: VALIDATED — Temporary blob storage in Supabase Storage. WebM format, 24h auto-delete after Hume processing. No long-term audio retention (privacy).
research_validated.R8_technique_taxonomy: VALIDATED — 83 total techniques identified across Voss, MI, CBT, NVC, corporate frameworks. 22 scored 5/5 for app practicability. 54 scored 3+/5. 16 of 23 score-5 techniques reuse labeling infrastructure (generic drill engine confirmed).
research_validated.R9_skill_tree_prerequisites: VALIDATED — 5-tier DAG with max depth 5. Adjacency list in Postgres. Hard prerequisites enforced via edge function. 5-level mastery system (0-4). Fundamentals track mandatory.
research_validated.R10_skills_lab_vs_simulation: VALIDATED — Tier A (10 drills-first), Tier B (10 simulation-preferred), Tier C (10 both). 5 drill formats. 3 simulation modes (guided → scaffolded → free-form). Drill mastery predicts 60-70% of simulation performance.
research_validated.R11_vcm_gate_prescriptions: VALIDATED — V2 structure with 9 gates (C3 Awareness and C4 Attention added). Behavioral signal detection via rule-based prescription engine. Diagnose internally, intervene externally. Never miss twice rule (37% longer habit retention).
research_validated.R12_institute_content: VALIDATED — Interleaved learning: practice-before-exposure. 5 content types, 6 quiz formats. AI-generated initially, professional content later. Content management in Supabase, not CMS.
research_validated.R13_cbt_mi_inventory: VALIDATED — 89 total CBT+MI techniques cataloged. 54 rated 3+/5 for app practice. Overlap with Voss identified (labeling ≈ complex reflection). Integration points mapped.
research_validated.R14_ai_opponent_prompts: VALIDATED — 4 system prompt templates across difficulty levels and domains. 3 control dials (assertiveness, reactivity, emotional_volatility). State object passed each turn. Hidden concern revelation stages.
research_validated.R15_spaced_repetition: VALIDATED — 3 decay rates by skill type: syntax (0.08/mo, 14d half-life), judgment (0.06/mo, 21d half-life), recognition (0.04/mo, 30d half-life). Simple interval fallback: [3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90] days. Implicit practice credits for prerequisite skills.
research_validated.R16_supabase_schema: VALIDATED — 22 tables, RLS policies, critical indexes, edge function stubs. Migration strategy from localStorage. Adjacency list for skill DAG. Behavioral events table for VCM signal detection.
research_validated.filler_awareness_behavior_change: VALIDATED — 80%+ reduction with awareness training alone. Immediate feedback reduces fillers 50%+. Feedback REDUCES anxiety.
research_validated.visual_feedback_retention: VALIDATED — 3.5x retention with visual gauges/charts (Duolingo case study). Real-time gauge + weekly trend = top priorities.
research_validated.safari_web_speech_api: PROBLEMATIC — 90% accuracy drop, critical bugs. Chrome-only for beta. Deepgram path for cross-browser later (~$0.015/min).
research_validated.filler_detection_accuracy: ASR-based (transcript) = 95%+ F1. Acoustic-only = 75-85% F1. Hybrid approach correct — transcript reconciliation catches acoustic misses.

technical_decisions.codebase: Local codebase (v2.0, Vercel-deployed). Lovable is reference only. (D1)
technical_decisions.design_system: Dark navy + gold (temporary). Will evolve via Framer exploration. Design tokens structured for easy swap. (D2)
technical_decisions.browser_support: Chrome-only for beta. Web Speech API for transcript. Deepgram path designed for cross-browser later (~$0.015/min). (D6)
technical_decisions.theme: Dark mode only. Light mode deferred to post-Framer design finalization. (D7)
technical_decisions.persistence: Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Storage + Edge Functions). 22-table schema. Migration from localStorage. (R6, R16)
technical_decisions.ai_simulation: Gemini 2.5 Flash for AI opponents. State object pattern per turn. ~$0.01-0.02 per 15-min session. (R4, R14)
technical_decisions.ai_evaluation: Gemini for technique detection and quality scoring. 4-dimension rubric. Per-turn and session-end. (R5)
technical_decisions.ai_summary: Gemini for post-session summaries and coaching feedback. Graceful degradation on API error (show local stats only).
technical_decisions.hume_integration: Batch only (not streaming). Backend proxy via Vercel serverless. Audio auto-delete after 24h. (R1, R7)
technical_decisions.filler_detection: Hybrid: acoustic detection real-time + transcript reconciliation at session end.
technical_decisions.skill_dag: Adjacency list in Postgres (skill_prerequisites table). Edge function checks prerequisites on-demand. Max depth 5, ~57 nodes. (R9, R16)
technical_decisions.spaced_repetition: Simple interval fallback: [3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90] days. 3 decay rates by skill type. Implicit practice credits. (R15)
technical_decisions.drill_engine: Generic engine supporting 5 formats. Same infrastructure serves all tiers — only evaluation rubric and mastery thresholds change per technique. (R10)
technical_decisions.vcm_diagnostics: Rule-based first. 8 gates, behavioral event logging. Graduate to ML after sufficient data. Diagnose internally, intervene externally. (R11)
technical_decisions.content_management: Content stored in Supabase (content_items, quiz_questions tables). Not a headless CMS. (R12)
technical_decisions.audio_recording: MediaRecorder API for capture. WebM format. Temporary storage in Supabase Storage for Hume batch. (R7)
